You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. ◈ THE WAR PATH — The body count, itemized. The System is not making this up — it was filming. On day 62, Penelope put down Ugly-Eyes.

"THE HERALD came. Named and located — the war council knew its face. They faced The Loud Beast and lived to sit here. They faced Ugly-Eyes and lived to sit here. Even now the wave-5 bar reads: blood your fighters (0 of 2 veterans)." — the System is still reading the list.
